text: Set up Higgsfield for me so I can generate images and videos from here.1. Install the CLI: run `npm i -g @higgsfield/cli`.2. Authenticate: run `higgsfield auth login` and complete the sign-in in the browser it opens.3. Install the companion skills: run `npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills`.Once that's done, let me know when it's ready.
